description: Declutter the Questions page and Practice page. The Questions page currently has 7 sections stacked vertically. Reduce to 2-3 focused sections. Practice page is similarly overloaded. Clean up with proper hierarchy and whitespace.
steps: Refactor src/app/(protected)/questions/page.tsx: Keep only (1) page title/description, (2) SessionConfigurator (the main action), (3) a collapsible 'Recent Activity' section that contains RecentAttemptsSection and RecentSessions behind a toggle. Remove SmartSessionCard (redundant - smart suggestions already in configurator), WeakTopicQuiz (move to its own feature accessible from analytics), QuestionAnalytics (belongs on Insights page). Keep the RelatedActions but reduce to 2-3 items max.

Refactor src/app/(protected)/practice/page.tsx: This page is already relatively clean. Keep it as-is but reduce RelatedActions to 2 items max. Ensure consistent spacing with the redesigned Questions page.
Refactor src/app/(protected)/flashcards/page.tsx: Already relatively clean. Just ensure consistent spacing and reduce RelatedActions to 2 items max.
For all pages: ensure consistent page header pattern - h1 title + short description + generous margin before content (mb-8 minimum between header and content).
Add a max-w-5xl mx-auto wrapper to the Questions page content for better readability on wide screens.
acceptance_criteria: Questions page shows max 3 visible sections by default (title, configurator, collapsible recent activity)
All practice/questions functionality still works (no broken imports or missing components)
Pages have consistent header pattern with proper spacing
RelatedActions reduced to 2-3 items per page
TypeScript compiles, lint passes, build succeeds
verification: rm -rf .next && eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
findings: Pre-existing lint errors in other files (18 errors, 8 warnings) unrelated to this change. All 3 modified files pass lint cleanly. Build and all 274 tests pass.
